checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Two separate finished assets: vertical still poster and 8s vertical reel
must.why: A 9:16 poster and a vertical 8s reel were delivered; frames sampled run to 7.6 s.

must.item: Both assets contain all five strings spelled exactly
must.why: All five strings are correct on the poster and in every sampled reel frame.

must.item: Warm illustrated stalls and string lights with a matching palette and design
must.why: The reel starts from the poster and keeps the same warm lantern-lit illustrated scene, though it drifts later.

must.item: Visible background animation while details stay readable throughout
must.why: The background moves a lot (lanterns, steam, a forward drift) and the text stays crisp in every frame. A lantern slightly touches the title at 5.6 s.
Audio can't be checked from still frames. The assistant says the reel has no sound.

faults.what: The reel scene drifts and morphs: the camera pushes forward and stalls and lanterns change shape, although a fixed camera was requested. By the end it looks quite different from the poster.
A lantern overlaps the 'Night Market' title at 5.6 s, which slightly reduces clarity.
The poster's text sits in plain bands (white title on the dark sky, dark text on a cream panel). The cream panel is flat and looks bolted on rather than designed in.
The reel is low resolution (480p) and has some painterly AI softness and artefacts.

summary: The poster and reel have all five texts spelled correctly, with a warm illustrated lantern-lit market and crisp, readable text throughout, but the reel background drifts and morphs more than a fixed-camera brief implies.
